question: How many customers have never placed an order?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: List the names of customers who have no email address
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders, where revenue is quantity times product price?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'

question: How many orders are there for each status?
reference_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Which product category has the highest total units sold?
reference_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Names of customers who placed more than 3 orders
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2026? Show the month as YYYY-MM
reference_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7), COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

question: What is the name of the most expensive product?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question: Names of products that have never been ordered
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question: How many cancelled orders were placed by customers living in Pune?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Pune' AND o.status = 'cancelled'

question: Names of customers who bought at least one product in the Electronics category
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'

question: How many customers live in each city?
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

question: Names of customers who signed up after June 30, 2025
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2025-06-30'

question: What is the average product price in each category?
reference_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category

question: Name of the customer whose single order had the highest total value (quantity times price, any status)
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 1
